result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a wide, well-maintained sidewalk and a curb ramp equipped with a tactile warning surface. While the pedestrian path is clear, the lack of marked crosswalks and the presence of parked cars near the intersection create visibility hazards. The environment appears to be a low-speed residential area but lacks enhanced crossing treatments.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block the sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at the intersection fails to clearly communicate pedestrian right-of-way to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground area where the sidewalk meets the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra-style crosswalk markings to increase the visibility of the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sight lines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.
